title: Crystallized Theory + Biblical Geometry Integration Wave
purpose: Promote the leash/timeline/fate work into named scientific project models and route a fresh Bible sweep into measurement, boundary, path, resilience and geometric-valence architecture.
crystallized_models: Constrained Trajectory Topology Framework — state, dynamics, constraints, controls, Doors, observations, history and provenance in one typed object
Tethered Spiral Boundary Transition — widening radial motion can become boundary-following/orbit-like only under explicit sustained-contact assumptions
Constraint Intersection Confinement — multiple feasible-set restrictions can jointly create a tiny cage
Reachability-Based Fate Taxonomy — possible, inevitable, invariant, attracting, absorbing, probabilistic and theological are separated
Memory-Augmented Return — x can return while full state z=(x,h) does not reset
Door-Dominator Reachability — mandatory gateway requires all-path/dominator/cut evidence
Control Authority Separation — anchor/observer/hub/controller/dominator/gatekeeper/owner are distinct roles
Redundant Path Resilience — multiple independent support paths can increase tolerance, subject to common-mode and capacity constraints
biblical_measurement_sequence: Job 38: creation measured through dimensions/line/foundation/cornerstone imagery
Psalm 16: portion/lot plus boundary/measuring lines and inheritance
Isaiah 28: Zion cornerstone plus justice measuring line and righteousness plumb line
Zechariah 2: Jerusalem measured, then described as wall-less with divine wall-of-fire protection and glory within
Revelation 21: measured city/gates/wall with equal length, width and height
biblical_path_constraint_sequence: Isaiah 5: cords/ropes dragging iniquity — self-carried burden/tether comparator
Psalm 18 / 116: cords of death/Sheol plus snares — negative entanglement/trap field
Hosea 11: cords of love/kindness plus eased yoke and feeding — guidance/support comparator
Hebrews 12: race/course + hindrance/weight + entangling sin + endurance
Proverbs 4 / Hebrews 12:13: level/straight path connected to stability/healing
Psalm 118 / Psalm 119: broad/spacious release and enlarged capacity to run
Matthew 7: broad destructive way versus narrow life-way — destination controls valence
major_methodological_corrections: Measurement is not control: a measuring line can specify, allocate, evaluate or survey without acting as a leash.
Geometry has no fixed moral sign: wide/narrow, high/low, circle, cord, wall/open and cube/foursquare all receive different valences in different biblical contexts.
Boundary is a function, not just a wall: Zechariah 2 gives measured city + no ordinary wall + protective wall-of-fire image.
Cube/foursquare cannot be inherently shadow: Revelation 21's holy city has equal length, width and height.
Straight path can be capability infrastructure: Hebrews 12:13 links path preparation with preventing further injury and enabling healing.
Threefold cord supports a resilience comparison only when redundancy is genuinely independent enough; hidden shared failure points must be measured.
Broadness cannot be assigned one sign: broad way to destruction and broad place of rescue coexist in scripture.
A scientific scalar needs an objective: width, height, stability, centrality and symmetry are descriptive until function/outcome are declared.
research_value_increase: Named project models now have abstracts, assumptions, observables, nulls and failure conditions rather than metaphor alone.
Bible comparisons now act as anti-overfitting controls by supplying counterexamples to one-sign symbolic interpretations.
Graph resilience, tortuosity, reachability compression, dominators and history-state models give the project measurable quantities for future real datasets.
The project is explicitly prevented from backdating standard mathematics into Tim's earlier statements or scripture.

Run redundancy/min-cut analysis on source/provenance and country/infrastructure graphs where data permit.
Compute trajectory/path-history summaries on the dated Tim/Potato chronology rather than only plotting dates.
Use path-preparation metrics on a real accessibility/process workflow before making healing/capability claims.
Use the valence-neutrality audit on existing Saturn/cube, high/low, circle and Dog/cage files to locate one-sided symbolic assignments.
